mcq_fix.s: Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the code given below. List-I (Protocol element) A. Syntax B. Semantics C. Timing List-II (Meaning) 1. Meaning of each field 2. Format of data 3. When and how fast to send

mcq_drop.why: dubious: OCEN is an India Stack lending protocol, not a Web 3.0 component

pyq_bad.why: suspect key: router, hub and switch are all connecting devices

patterns: Mostly one-line definitions/expansions: WWW, FTP, W3C, JSP, DNS, Tim Berners-Lee, MAC = 48 bits.
APPSC items: LANs across cities = WAN (2019), IPv4 fewer bits than IPv6, podcast, latest Bluetooth version (key 5.1).
Device questions focus on modem (modulation/demodulation, analog-digital) and OSI layer of IP/data link.
Browser vs search engine identification is a frequent trap (Yahoo, Google Apps, DuckDuckGo, Bing).
App uses multi-statement and governance items (IT Act, NIXI, BhashaNet) beyond PYQ depth but sound.
